title: Win Streak May Continue For South Korea Shares
text:
Win Streak May Continue For South Korea Shares September 27, 2018, 07:00: South Korea stock market has finished higher in three straight sessions, gathering more than 45 points or 2 percent along the way. The KOSPI now rests just above the 2,355-point plateau, and it may add to its winnings KOSPI finished modestly higher on Thursday following gains from the financial shares and the industrial issues, while the technology stocks were mixed.
For the day, the index gained 16.26 points or 0.70 percent to finish at the daily high of 2,355.43 after moving as low as 2,331.70. Volume was 273 million shares worth 7.12 trillion won. There were 522 gainers and 312 decliners.
Among the actives, Shinhan Financial collected 0.90 percent, while KB Financial gathered 0.94 percent, Woori Bank gathered 0.30 percent, Hana Financial dropped 0.80 percent, Samsung Electronics advanced 0.21 percent, SK hynix tumbled 2.22 percent, LG Electronics perked 0.14 percent, SK Telecom soared 2.04 percent, KEPCO was up 0.70 percent, Hyundai Motor climbed 1.16 percent, Kia Motors spiked 2.03 percent, POSCO added 0.33 percent and LG Chem gained 0.82 percent.
